title: 第17章 前往苍山
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
苍山开启就在这几日，由于瑶池离苍山有几日的路程，需得提前几日出发。

    路仙瑶让人叫来墨燃和萧烬，一道乘坐鎏金飞船过去。

    墨燃喜欢粘着路仙瑶，自然兴高采烈地来了，但萧烬过来时顶着一张臭脸，她好像欠他似的。

    她还没开口，他却先冷声开口，“前段时间也不知道是谁说，对云鹤珏没有半分心思，如今才过了多久，便眼巴巴的上赶着贴过去了？”

    萧烬瞧她带了那么多护卫，也不知道这回带了多少宝贝送去。

    她上次仗着圣子在，让云鹤珏自斩修为，这对于修道之人来讲，无疑是自寻死路，云鹤珏自然恨极了她，即便她带再多宝贝，也不可能会原谅她的。

    真不知道她是图什么？

    路仙瑶：？？？

    他叽里咕噜在说什么呢？

    去趟苍山都能扯上云鹤珏？

    “你确定不去？”她问。

    “不去！”萧烬冷着脸别过头，“谁知道你是想让我给云鹤珏做什么？”

    她从前为了让云鹤珏修炼精进得更快，日日逼他炼丹，他守着滚烫的丹鼎，整个人烫得跟剥了层皮似的，她却半分不在意，眼里只有云鹤珏。

    以及得知云鹤珏受伤时，不顾他烫伤未愈，拖着他去天鸣剑宗救人，过往种种他可没忘！

    “这跟云鹤珏又有什么关系？”路仙瑶觉得他莫名其妙的，“算了，你不去就不去，我带墨燃去，墨燃，我们走。”

    “嗯嗯。”墨燃点头。

    在他随路仙瑶上飞船前，还是想再问一次萧烬，“萧师兄，你真的不去吗？”

    “我说不去就不去！”萧烬坚持。

    “唉，好吧……”墨燃叹了口气，“我还以为苍山里有那么多奇珍异宝，你会很感兴趣呢。”

    “苍山？”萧烬愣住。

    “是啊！”墨燃点头，大大的眼睛满是疑惑对去苍山有什么问题。

    “难道不是去天鸣剑宗？”萧烬追问。
content_en:
Cangshan Mountain opens in these few days. Since Yaochi is several days away from Cangshan Mountain, we need to set off a few days in advance.

    Lu Xianyao asked people to call Mo Ran and Xiao Jin, and they took the gilded spaceship over together.

    Mo Ran liked to stick to Lu Xianyao, so he came happily, but Xiao Jin had a bad face when he came over, as if she owed him.

    Before she could speak, he spoke coldly, "I don't know who said some time ago that I didn't care about Yun Hejue at all, but now how long has it been before I rush to him eagerly?"

    Xiao Jin saw that she had brought so many guards, and he didn't know how many treasures she had brought with her this time.

    The last time she relied on the presence of the Holy Son to let Yun Hejue kill himself, which for a Taoist cultivator was undoubtedly seeking death. Yun Hejue naturally hated her so much that no matter how many treasures she brought, he would never forgive her.

    I really don’t know what she’s after?

    Lu Xianyao:? ? ?

    What is he talking about?

    Can you hook up with Yun Hejue even if you go to Cangshan Mountain?

    "Are you sure you don't want to go?" she asked.

    "No!" Xiao Jin turned away with a cold face, "Who knows what you want me to do for Yun Hejue?"

    In the past, she had forced Yun Hejue to refine elixirs every day in order to make him improve faster. He was guarding the hot elixir cauldron, and his whole body was as hot as if he had peeled off a layer of skin. However, she didn't care at all, and only had Yun Hejue in her eyes.

    And when he learned that Yun Hejue was injured, he dragged him to the Tianming Sword Sect to save people, regardless of the fact that his burns were not healed. He has never forgotten all the past events!

    "What does this have to do with Yun Hejue?" Lu Xianyao thought he was confused, "Forget it, if you don't want to go, you won't go. I'll take Mo Ran, Mo Ran, let's go."

    "Yeah." Mo Ran nodded.

    Before he followed Lu Xianyao onto the spaceship, he still wanted to ask Xiao Jin one more time, "Senior Brother Xiao, are you really not going?"

    "I won't go if I don't want to!" Xiao Jin insisted.

    "Oh, okay..." Mo Ran sighed, "I thought you would be very interested in there being so many rare treasures in Cangshan Mountain."

    "Cangshan?" Xiao Jin was stunned.

    "Yes!" Mo Ran nodded, his big eyes full of doubts about going to Cangshan.

    "Don't you want to go to Tianming Sword Sect?" Xiao Jin asked.
